newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends barely higher after dull session.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends barely higher after dull session.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed slightly higher after a dull, featureless session with many players absent to attend an industry conference.
A trader said there was some options related buying early in the session which helped to lift the market, but tags slipped later to end just off the day's low.
March cotton settled 0.06 cent firmer at 74.14 cents per pound, traded with a narrow range between 74.74 and 74.05 cents.
Volume was estimated at 8,500 lots, well down from Friday's official 13,279 lots.
Many players are away attending the Beltwide Conference in New Orleans, Jan 7 to 10.
In particular traders were waiting for a speech from leading cotton merchant William B Dunavant due Tuesday afternoon.
"I don't think there will be any surprises from the speech," a trader said.
